builds.howItPlays: You put Brutalizer, Doran's Blade and Guardian Angel on one unit, a Stellacorn Herder, Lucian or Jax, and use Jax's free exhaust ability to move a piece of gear onto whichever unit is about to fight. Once Jax, Unmatched is out, the Equipment in your hand can be played on your opponent's turn and attached right away, while Counter Strike keeps your carrier alive through their damage so it can take and hold battlefields.
builds.whyYou: You like building one unit up until the other player has to deal with it, and then making sure they can't. You enjoy holding a trick for their turn, whether that's a surprise piece of gear or a spell that blocks the damage they were counting on, and you'd rather protect a lead than race. Jax suits you if you want every turn to ask which unit carries the gear and what you're keeping back to protect it, with a deck whose cards do the same job every game.
builds.ratingNotes: Scored decks: https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/9434ddc4-8b72-4872-afdb-b543546f0ab1 (Best of Jax Hartford, Edward Jones) 5/5/7.5/3.5 Tempo; https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/0ee4fe49-a5f7-4d71-afd0-257116daec39 (Singapore RQ Best of, Kudos) 5/5/7/4 Tempo; https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/3d46c5e3-0f2b-43e0-a82d-17317c4d819e (fatboyyy124 guide) 5/5/7/4 Tempo. Mean 5/5/7/4, labels Tempo x3 (tools.ts style). Adjustments (all three sheets): complexity +1, because the Legend re-attaches Equipment every turn and you decide each turn which unit carries the gear. No Axis had a formula-judgment gap of 2 or more. Deciding cards: Pace comes from cheap units (First Mate, Lonely Poro, Scuttle Crab) weighed against 5-cost Jax, Unmatched and Rengar. Stance sits in the middle because pressure bodies (Lucian, Merciless, Irelia) are balanced by answers and protection (Counter Strike, Defy, Guardian Angel, Challenge, Rampage). Complexity is high from many reaction-speed cards (Equipment given Quick-Draw by Jax, Unmatched, plus Counter Strike, Defy, Discipline, En Garde) and setup cards (Brutalizer's attached-this-turn bonus, Stellacorn Herder drawing on move). Variance is low because of full playsets, no luck cards and card draw from Counter Strike and Herder. Legend ability: [1], Exhaust: attach a detached Equipment you control to a unit you control; Exhaust: move an attached Equipment you control to another unit you control (SFD). Re-attaching Brutalizer each turn re-triggers its +2 Might.
